sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Matina Steves-Gridnev, in for Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的马蒂娜·斯蒂夫斯-格里德涅夫，替萨布丽娜主持。

sentences.en: And this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Russia's invasion of Ukraine put the global food supply at risk until the two countries struck an unusual deal to keep food shipments flowing.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯入侵乌克兰使全球粮食供应面临风险，直到两国达成一项不同寻常的协议以保持粮食运输畅通。

sentences.en: Last week, that deal fell apart.
sentences.zh: 上周，这项协议破裂了。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Mark Santora on what the collapse of the deal means for the war and why its impact will be felt by tens of millions of people across the world.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事马克·桑托拉将探讨该协议的破裂对战争意味着什么，以及为什么其影响将被全球数千万人感受到。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, July 25th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月25日，星期二。

sentences.en: Mark, tell me about this deal that fell apart last week and why it's so significant.
sentences.zh: 马克，请跟我讲讲上周破裂的这项协议，以及为什么它如此重要。

sentences.en: Very simply, Matina, it's about feeding the world.
sentences.zh: 很简单，马蒂娜，这关乎养活世界。

sentences.en: Between the two of them, Russia and Ukraine, provide just a ton of the world's food supply.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰加起来，供应了世界上绝大部分的粮食。

sentences.en: Russia and Ukraine produce about 30% of the world's wheat and barley.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰生产了大约30%的世界小麦和大麦。

sentences.en: 20% of corn comes from Russia and the Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 20%的玉米来自俄罗斯和乌克兰。

sentences.en: 80% of sunflower oil, palm oil, which is used...
sentences.zh: 80%的葵花籽油、棕榈油，这些被用于……

sentences.en: Ukraine is one of the world's leading suppliers of grain, barley, rapeseed oil, sunflower seeds, and a host of other products.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰是全球主要的粮食、大麦、菜籽油、葵花籽以及许多其他产品的主要供应商之一。

sentences.en: Russia's invasion of Ukraine has upended the flow of food around the world.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯对乌克兰的入侵颠覆了全球粮食的流向。

sentences.en: But the moment Russia launched its full-scale invasion, it also instituted a naval blockade on all of Ukraine's Black Sea ports.
sentences.zh: 但就在俄罗斯发动全面入侵的那一刻，它也对乌克兰的所有黑海港口实施了海军封锁。

sentences.en: They laid sea mines, trapping the ships that were meant to deliver millions of tons of grain to the global market.
sentences.zh: 他们布设了水雷，困住了原本打算向全球市场交付数百万吨粮食的船只。

sentences.en: Around 25 million tons of grain are stuck in the country.
sentences.zh: 大约有2500万吨粮食被困在境内。

sentences.en: Some of it is stored in silos like these in the port of Odessa, waiting for export.
sentences.zh: 其中一些存放在敖德萨港口这样的筒仓里，等待出口。

sentences.en: So, all of that just went off the market overnight.
sentences.zh: 所以，所有这些在一夜之间就退出了市场。

sentences.en: The food supply for millions of Ukrainians, and millions more around the world, has quite literally been held hostage by the Russian military.
sentences.zh: 数百万乌克兰人以及全球数百万人的粮食供应，毫不夸张地被俄罗斯军方劫持了。

sentences.en: But, for Russia's part, they're the global leader in exporting fertilizer around the world.
sentences.zh: 但就俄罗斯而言，他们是全球化肥出口的领导者。

sentences.en: The war starts, and the exporting of that fertilizer becomes incredibly more difficult for Russia because of the sanctions that are put on them.
sentences.zh: 战争爆发了，由于对其实施的制裁，俄罗斯化肥的出口变得异常困难。

sentences.en: So, you have a situation where crops are stuck in Ukraine, and the stuff that helps those crops grow is harder to move out of Russia, and food prices soar.
sentences.zh: 因此，你面临这样一种情况：农作物被困在乌克兰，而帮助这些农作物生长的物资更难运出俄罗斯，粮食价格飙升。

sentences.en: So, when it became clear that this war was not going to be a quick war, but a lasting war, international pressure began to build to try and find some sort of solution.
sentences.zh: 因此，当人们清楚这场战争不会是一场速战速决的战争，而是一场持久战时，国际压力开始积聚，试图寻找某种解决方案。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that solution is an agreement to restart food shipments.
sentences.zh: 而这个解决方案就是重启粮食运输的协议。

sentences.en: So, how does that come together?
sentences.zh: 那么，这是如何达成的呢？

sentences.en: So, in April of last year, Ukraine and Russia agreed to begin to talk about this growing problem.
sentences.zh: 因此，在去年4月，乌克兰和俄罗斯同意开始讨论这个日益严重的问题。

sentences.en: They won't do it with each other, but they agreed to start discussing ways to possibly find a solution, and they do that in Turkey.
sentences.zh: 他们不会直接与对方交谈，但他们同意在土耳其开始讨论寻找解决方案的可能途径。

sentences.en: And Turkey's central role in all this makes sense, just even if you look at the map.
sentences.zh: 即使只看地图，土耳其在这一切中的核心作用也是合乎情理的。

sentences.en: Turkey controls the only way in and out of the Black Sea, where all these ships from Ukraine would have to go through, right?
sentences.zh: 土耳其控制着进出黑海的唯一通道，所有这些来自乌克兰的船只都必须通过这里，对吧？

sentences.en: That's right, Matina.
sentences.zh: 没错，马蒂娜。

sentences.en: They are the ones who determine what ships can pass through, civilian cargo vessels and others.
sentences.zh: 他们是决定哪些船只可以通过的人，包括民用货船和其他船只。

sentences.en: And so, in order for any ship to get safe passage, the first step is for Turkey to grant passage into the Black Sea.
sentences.zh: 因此，为了让任何船只获得安全通行，第一步是土耳其批准进入黑海的通道。

sentences.en: And here you have the situation where the Turkish leader, President Erdogan, who has relationships both with Moscow and with Ukraine, with the West and with the East,
sentences.zh: 在这里，土耳其领导人埃尔多安总统与莫斯科和乌克兰、西方和东方都保持着关系，

sentences.en: tries to position himself as sort of the mediator here, the person who can find a solution to one of the deepest and most complex global problems
sentences.zh: 他试图把自己定位为这里的调解人，一个能够找到解决俄罗斯入侵乌克兰引发的最深层、最复杂全球问题之一的人。

sentences.en: that arose from Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 源于俄罗斯对乌克兰的入侵。

sentences.en: Well, I remember covering these talks in Istanbul and just felt like a bit of a mission impossible to get Russia to back off and agree to anything.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我记得在伊斯坦布尔报道这些会谈时，感觉要让俄罗斯做出让步并同意任何事情简直像是不可能的任务。

sentences.en: But I remember thinking maybe Erdogan, maybe the Turkish president, would be able to pull it off.
sentences.zh: 但我记得当时想，也许埃尔多安，也许这位土耳其总统，能够成功办到。

sentences.en: Yeah, amazingly, he does.
sentences.zh: 是的，令人惊奇的是，他做到了。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, when the parties were actually finally brought together to sign this agreement,
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道，当各方最终聚在一起签署这项协议时，

sentences.en: the depth of the division and the challenges in making it happen were evident in the signing ceremony itself.
sentences.zh: 分歧的深度和实现这一目标的挑战在签字仪式本身就显而易见。

sentences.en: Today, there is a beacon on the Black Sea, a beacon of hope, a beacon of possibility, a beacon of relief.
sentences.zh: 今天，黑海之上出现了一盏明灯，一盏希望的明灯，一盏可能性的明灯，一盏救济的明灯。

sentences.en: They had a grand table laid out with flowers and all the usual statecraft that goes into the signing of a treaty where you'd have two parties come together and sign a document.
sentences.zh: 他们摆放了一张铺着鲜花的豪华桌子，以及签署条约时所需的所有常规政治手段，两方汇聚一堂签署文件。

sentences.en: In this case, the Russians came out first, onto the stage, signed it, and then left.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，俄罗斯人首先走上舞台，签字，然后离开。

sentences.en: The Ukrainians separately came out, and they signed, and they left.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰人随后分别上台，签署，然后离开。

sentences.en: Never at any point did Russia and Ukraine make a deal together.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰在任何时候都没有达成共同协议。

sentences.en: Rather, what they had was a deal through Turkey and the United Nations to get the grain moving again.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们达成的是通过土耳其和联合国重新启动粮食运输的协议。

sentences.en: The signature ceremony has ended.
sentences.zh: 签字仪式已经结束。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I remember watching that moment, and it was just so fragile, so delicate.
sentences.zh: 我记得看那个时刻，它是那么脆弱，那么纤细。

sentences.en: And you could really see that in the careful choreography of making sure that the two officials would never actually be on stage at the same time.
sentences.zh: 你真的可以通过精心的编排看出这一点，确保两名官员实际上永远不会同时出现在舞台上。

sentences.en: Yeah, and you have to remember the emotions, too, here.
sentences.zh: 是的，你还必须记住这里的情绪。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, the atrocities in Bucha had come to light.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，布恰的暴行已经曝光。

sentences.en: You had Russia raining missiles down on towns and cities across the country, occupying something like 25% of the land.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯在全国各地的城镇倾泻导弹，占领了大约25%的土地。

sentences.en: And it's incredible that they were able to find some way forward on this.
sentences.zh: 真难以置信他们能够在这方面找到某种前进的道路。

sentences.en: So let's walk through exactly what was in that deal.
sentences.zh: 那么让我们仔细看看该协议的具体内容。

sentences.en: What did each side agree to?
sentences.zh: 双方都同意了什么？

sentences.en: So, Matina, the deal basically has two parts.
sentences.zh: 所以，马蒂娜，协议基本上分为两部分。

sentences.en: First, you have the UN promising that it's going to help Russia get better and cheaper terms to let it export its own fertilizer.
sentences.zh: 首先，联合国承诺将帮助俄罗斯获得更好、更便宜的条件来出口其自己的化肥。

sentences.en: Essentially, it's the UN saying that it's going to help ease sanctions put on Moscow for launching its invasion of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 本质上，联合国表示将帮助放松因莫斯科对乌克兰发动入侵而对其施加的制裁。

sentences.en: In exchange, Russia says it'll grant safe passage for cargo ships through the Black Sea,
sentences.zh: 作为交换，俄罗斯表示将为货船通过黑海提供安全通道，

sentences.en: helping them navigate a maze of maritime mines and also pest its own warships to bring the grain out of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 帮助它们避开水雷迷阵，并部署自己的军舰将粮食运出乌克兰。

sentences.en: And then, to be sure the ships aren't smuggling goods or ammunition or other things,
sentences.zh: 然后，为了确保船只没有走私货物、弹药或其他东西，

sentences.en: there will be an inspection center set up in Istanbul with people from both Ukraine and Russia who can inspect the ships as they leave.
sentences.zh: 将在伊斯坦布尔建立一个检查中心，由乌克兰和俄罗斯的人员组成，他们可以在船只离开时对其进行检查。

sentences.en: So Russian officials and Ukrainian officials are going to be working together in this small space in Istanbul to get the grain ships moving again.
sentences.zh: 因此，俄罗斯官员和乌克兰官员将在伊斯坦布尔这个小空间里合作，让运粮船重新起航。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, even though the deal itself isn't between Russia and Ukraine,
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，尽管协议本身不是在俄罗斯和乌克兰之间达成的，

sentences.en: you have a situation where you have the two parties basically operating in this little joint center to try and get this grain onto the market again.
sentences.zh: 但你面临这样一种情况：双方基本上在这个小型联合中心运作，试图让这些粮食重新进入市场。

sentences.en: And the place we're going to see if this deal is going to work and the most important place for it to succeed is in the southern Ukrainian port city of Odessa.
sentences.zh: 我们将看到这项协议是否奏效的地方，也是它成功的最重要地方，是乌克兰南部的港口城市敖德萨。

sentences.en: And why is Odessa so important?
sentences.zh: 为什么敖德萨如此重要？

sentences.en: So Odessa has economic, militarily strategic, and symbolic importance.
sentences.zh: 因此，敖德萨具有经济、军事战略和象征意义。

sentences.en: First of all, it's the largest port in Ukraine, and it's sort of a remarkable sight to see.
sentences.zh: 首先，它是乌克兰最大的港口，而且这是一种非凡的景象。

sentences.en: Cranes rising high in the sky, dozens and dozens of them, train lines leading into this sprawling shipyard and port.
sentences.zh: 高耸入云的起重机，成数十台，铁路通向这个庞大的造船厂和港口。

sentences.en: There are warehouses, there's fuel depots.
sentences.zh: 有仓库，有燃料库。

sentences.en: Basically, it's not only a vital part of the economy in Odessa, but for Ukraine more broadly.
sentences.zh: 基本上，它不仅是敖德萨经济的重要组成部分，对更广泛的乌克兰也是如此。

sentences.en: So when Putin announced his invasion, there was a feeling that the Kremlin thought it could take Odessa without having to destroy Odessa.
sentences.zh: 因此，当普京宣布入侵时，有一种感觉认为克里姆林宫认为它可以在不摧毁敖德萨的情况下占领敖德萨。

sentences.en: And in the first weeks of the war, I remember, one of the few places that was somewhat unscathed by Russian missiles and bombs was Odessa.
sentences.zh: 在战争的头几周，我记得，敖德萨是少数几个几乎未受俄罗斯导弹和炸弹袭击的地方之一。

sentences.en: The first bombing wasn't recorded until, I think it was three or four weeks into the war itself, and that was just on the outskirts of Odessa.
sentences.zh: 第一次轰炸记录直到战争爆发三四周后才出现，而且只是在敖德萨的郊区。

sentences.en: But the city still suffered.
sentences.zh: 但这座城市仍然遭受了痛苦。

sentences.en: With the naval blockade, the port was completely shut down.
sentences.zh: 随着海军封锁，港口完全关闭。

sentences.en: The economic engine of the city stops running.
sentences.zh: 城市的经济引擎停止运转。

sentences.en: Russian warships menace off the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯军舰在海岸附近虎视眈眈。

sentences.en: There's a threat of an amphibious invasion.
sentences.zh: 存在着两栖入侵的威胁。

sentences.en: People go to the beach not for leisure, but to pack sand in the sandbags.
sentences.zh: 人们去海滩不是为了休闲，而是为了在沙袋里装沙子。

sentences.en: And so a city known for its celebration of life and its sense of humor and its raucousness and its joie de vivre is gone silent to a large degree.
sentences.zh: 因此，一个以庆祝生命、幽默感、喧闹和热爱生活而闻名的城市在很大程度上陷入了沉默。

sentences.en: So set against that tense backdrop, the first ship is loaded with grain in a port in Odessa.
sentences.zh: 因此，在那种紧张的背景下，第一艘船在敖德萨的一个港口装满了粮食。

sentences.en: And on August 1st of last year, it sets out to sea.
sentences.zh: 去年8月1日，它出海了。

sentences.en: It's really this sort of dramatic scene all across the city as the captain pulls out.
sentences.zh: 当船长驶离时，整个城市实际上呈现出这样一幅戏剧性的场景。

sentences.en: He gives the traditional three blasts of the horn.
sentences.zh: 他按响了传统的长鸣三声汽笛。

sentences.en: And people across the city, they stop, and people have tears in their eyes.
sentences.zh: 全城的人都停了下来，人们眼里含着泪水。

sentences.en: It's like, okay, maybe the port might start to come back to life.
sentences.zh: 这就像是，好吧，也许港口可能会开始恢复生机。

sentences.en: And so does life come back to Odessa and the port?
sentences.zh: 那么敖德萨和港口恢复生机了吗？

sentences.en: Well, obviously, it's nothing like it is before the war.
sentences.zh: 很明显，这与战前完全不能相比。

sentences.en: But ships are coming into Odessa again.
sentences.zh: 但船只再次驶入敖德萨。

sentences.en: They are being loaded with grain.
sentences.zh: 它们正在装载粮食。

sentences.en: They are making their way out to the global market.
sentences.zh: 它们正在驶向全球市场。

sentences.en: Workers are filling those ships, and captains are sailing them out to sea.
sentences.zh: 工人们正在装满这些船只，船长们正驾驶它们出海。

sentences.en: Every few months, the deal basically had to be renewed.
sentences.zh: 每隔几个月，该协议基本上都必须续签。

sentences.en: And so there would be these periods where the amount of ships allowed in would slow, and there would be questions of if it would be renewed and tensions around it.
sentences.zh: 因此会有这样一些时期：允许进入的船只数量放缓，并且会出现是否会续签的问题以及围绕它的紧张局势。

sentences.en: But really, for the most part, it held.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，在大多数情况下，它坚持了下来。

sentences.en: And over the course of the entire initiative, something like 33 million tons of grain was able to make its way from the Black Sea to the global market.
sentences.zh: 在整个倡议期间，大约有3300万吨粮食得以从黑海运往全球市场。

sentences.en: So, for a while there, it looks like this global food crisis, this meltdown, has kind of been averted, right?
sentences.zh: 所以在一段时间里，看起来这场全球粮食危机、这场崩溃在某种程度上被避免了，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, remarkably, the deal holds.
sentences.zh: 是的，值得注意的是，协议维持了下来。

sentences.en: There are problems and hiccups, but grain is moving until it isn't.
sentences.zh: 虽然有问题和波折，但粮食一直在运送，直到不再运送。

sentences.en: And the deal falls apart.
sentences.zh: 协议破裂了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是维纳洛。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的益智游戏《连线》。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天创作拼字游戏和格子游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚刚听到的人一样。

sentences.en: Mark, what happens?
sentences.zh: 马克，发生了什么？

sentences.en: Why does the deal fall apart so suddenly?
sentences.zh: 为什么协议这么突然就破裂了？

sentences.en: The agreement, which assures Ukrainian grain can be transported through the Black Sea, is due to expire on July 17.
sentences.zh: 确保乌克兰粮食能够通过黑海运输的协议定于7月17日到期。

sentences.en: The groundbreaking deal has been renewed three times since its first signing, but it may not be renewed again.
sentences.zh: 这项具有突破性的协议自首次签署以来已续签三次，但可能不会再次续签。

sentences.en: Well, I think we started to see the tension building as the renewal date started to approach.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想随着续签日期的临近，我们开始看到紧张局势不断加剧。

sentences.en: One of the last two ships carrying grain through the Black Sea Corridor anchored at Istanbul
sentences.zh: 通过黑海走廊运送粮食的最后两艘船之一停泊在伊斯坦布尔。

sentences.en: Saturday.
sentences.zh: 星期六。

sentences.en: By the end of June, the last ship approved by Russia to be part of this deal came into the ports in Odessa.
sentences.zh: 到6月底，获得俄罗斯批准成为该协议一部分的最后一艘船进入了敖德萨的港口。

sentences.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin is threatening to walk away from the Black Sea grain deal unless some sanctions are lifted.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京威胁说，除非取消某些制裁，否则他将退出黑海粮食协议。

sentences.en: And then, as the date of the renewal drew closer, we saw Putin get more fiery in his rhetoric and start to make more demands and say, essentially, enough is enough.
sentences.zh: 然后，随着续签日期的临近，我们看到普京的言辞变得更加激烈，开始提出更多要求，并且基本上表示够了就是够了。

sentences.en: And then, last week, Monday, Moscow says it won't extend the agreement.
sentences.zh: 然后，在上周一，莫斯科表示不会延长协议。

sentences.en: The Kremlin says they're done.
sentences.zh: 克里姆林宫表示他们受够了。

sentences.en: That night, bombs start falling on the port in Odessa.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，炸弹开始落在敖德萨的港口上。

sentences.en: The next day, you have the Kremlin say that any ship that is seen sailing towards Ukraine will be considered hostile and could be blown out of the water.
sentences.zh: 第二天，克里姆林宫表示，任何被视为驶向乌克兰的船只都将被视为敌对船只，并可能被炸沉。

sentences.en: A second night of what Ukraine describes as hellish aerial assault by Russia on the city of Odessa.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰称这是俄罗斯对敖德萨市发动的第二晚犹如人间地狱般的空袭。

sentences.en: And then the next night, Odessa is bombed again.
sentences.zh: 然后在第二天晚上，敖德萨再次遭到轰炸。

sentences.en: And the next night.
sentences.zh: 接着是下一个晚上。

sentences.en: These were targeted attacks in exactly the place where grain exports are to take place.
sentences.zh: 这些都是有针对性的袭击，正中粮食出口要发生的地方。

sentences.en: And this has now become probably the most intense bombardment sustained by Odessa throughout the course of the 16-month war.
sentences.zh: 这现在已经成为在16个月的战争期间敖德萨所遭受的可能最激烈的轰炸。

sentences.en: I was there for a few nights of it, and the attack would come in waves.
sentences.zh: 我在那里呆了几个夜晚，袭击是一波接一波地来的。

sentences.en: It would be attack drones.
sentences.zh: 袭击者是无人机。

sentences.en: It would be missiles fired on a ballistic trajectory to give them this incredible speed.
sentences.zh: 还有沿弹道轨迹发射的导弹，这赋予了它们惊人的速度。

sentences.en: Russia was also firing anti-ship missiles.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯还发射了反舰导弹。

sentences.en: And these missiles, they skim along the surface of the sea, making them remarkably hard to shoot down.
sentences.zh: 这些导弹贴着海面飞行，极难被击落。

sentences.en: And Odessa, spared early in the war, now finds itself squarely in Moscow's crosshairs.
sentences.zh: 而敖德萨在战争初期曾幸免于难，如今却成了莫斯科直接瞄准的目标。

sentences.en: What a devastating, remarkable 180 in basically less than a week, from deal to no deal, from relative peace to all-out bombardment.
sentences.zh: 在不到一周的时间里，从达成协议到协议破裂，从相对的和平到全面轰炸，这是一个多么毁灭性且令人震惊的180度大转弯。

sentences.en: Why do we think Russia is doing this?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们认为俄罗斯要这样做？

sentences.en: Well, there is first the Kremlin's stated reason, which is they say they're not getting what they want out of this deal.
sentences.zh: 首先是克里姆林宫陈述的理由，他们称自己没有从这项协议中得到想要的东西。

sentences.en: Well, the sanctions are not being eased in a way that they find sufficient for their participation.
sentences.zh: 制裁没有以他们认为足够满足其参与度的方式得到放宽。

sentences.en: Of course, they add stuff to what they say they want, and the Ukrainians see it as just nothing but pure blackmail.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们在自己声称的要求中又添加了新内容，而乌克兰人认为这纯粹是勒索。

sentences.en: But second, whatever the Kremlin says, it's also important to keep in mind just what a different place we're in now than when this deal was first negotiated and agreed to back
sentences.zh: 但其次，无论克里姆林宫怎么说，同样重要的是要记住，与最初谈判并达成该协议时相比

sentences.en: in August of last summer.
sentences.zh: 即去年夏天八月份时，我们现在所处的情境已经发生了多么大的变化。

sentences.en: Russia is in a much weakened state, and so, quite frankly, is President Putin, who just faced an uprising within his own ranks of his military.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯目前处于严重削弱的状态，坦率地说，刚刚面临军队内部叛乱的普京总统也是如此。

sentences.en: And so, in this weakened position, one of the levers that Moscow still has at its disposal is the economic pressure it's putting on the country.
sentences.zh: 因此，在这个削弱的地位下，莫斯科仍然可以支配的手段之一就是它对该国施加的经济压力。

sentences.en: Because the export of agricultural goods and grain is an essential part of the Ukrainian economy, the shutting off of that has a real impact.
sentences.zh: 由于农产品和谷物的出口是乌克兰经济的重要组成部分，切断这一出口产生了真正的冲击。

sentences.en: And then thirdly, globally, Russia is showing that it can still wreak havoc on a very important global market.
sentences.zh: 第三，在全球范围内，俄罗斯正在表明它仍然能够在至关重要的全球市场上大肆破坏。

sentences.en: In this case, the food market.
sentences.zh: 在这里，指的就是食品市场。

sentences.en: And again, the Ukrainians say it's Russia using food as a weapon, trying to hold the world hostage to its demands, saying, we will not allow this food to go out unless you give
sentences.zh: 同样，乌克兰人表示，这是俄罗斯在将食品作为武器，试图以其要求将世界作为人质，声称除非你们满足

sentences.en: us what we want.
sentences.zh: 我们的要求，否则我们绝不允许这些食品运出去。

sentences.en: The U.S.-Europeans agree with that assessment, that what Russia is doing here is just essentially blackmail.
sentences.zh: 美欧双方都认同这种评估，即俄罗斯此举本质上就是勒索。

sentences.en: So, essentially, this would be a way to sort of stick it to the international community for the Russians.
sentences.zh: 所以，从根本上说，这对俄罗斯人来说是一种给国际社会狠狠来一下的方式。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全如此。

sentences.en: And perhaps their hope is that they could then, by pressuring the international community, hope the international community then puts pressure on Ukraine to look for some sort
sentences.zh: 也许他们的希望是，通过向国际社会施压，希望国际社会随后向乌克兰施压，以寻求某种

sentences.en: of negotiated settlement, which, quite frankly, does not seem to be on the table at the moment in any fashion.
sentences.zh: 通过谈判解决的方案，而坦率地说，目前这种方案在任何方面似乎都不在考虑范围内。

sentences.en: So, given all that, where do we stand a week since the deal collapsed?
sentences.zh: 鉴于这一切，自协议破裂一周以来，我们的处境如何？

sentences.en: So, again, remember, the Kremlin said it will deem any ship trying to travel to Ukraine to export grain hostile, meaning they reserve the right to shoot it out of the water.
sentences.zh: 再次提醒，克里姆林宫曾表示，它将把任何试图前往乌克兰出口谷物的船只视为敌对目标，这意味着他们保留将其炸沉的权利。

sentences.en: And then the Ukrainians said they will view any ship moving out of either Russian-occupied
sentences.zh: 随后，乌克兰方面表示，他们将把任何驶离俄罗斯占领的

sentences.en: ports in southern Ukraine or Russian ports on the Black Sea itself as potentially hostile, setting up this incredibly tense environment on the Black Sea itself.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰南部港口或黑海俄罗斯本土港口的船只视为潜在敌对目标，这在黑海本身营造了一种极其紧张的环境。

sentences.en: And so, you have surging grain prices, and you have 29 ships that are basically just waiting now, out at sea, hoping, maybe, that they could get to a port in Ukraine and load up
sentences.zh: 因此，谷物价格飙升，还有29艘船目前基本上只能在海上等待，或许幻想着能进入乌克兰的港口装载

sentences.en: with grain.
sentences.zh: 谷物。

sentences.en: Mark, is there any credible way out of this?
sentences.zh: 马克，有没有什么切实可行的出路？

sentences.en: Well, Matina, short of Russia rejoining the initiative, which, given the events of the past week, Moscow's given no indication they intend to do, the options are pretty risky.
sentences.zh: 玛蒂娜，除非俄罗斯重新加入这一倡议，但鉴于过去一周的事件，莫斯科没有表示出任何打算这样做的迹象，否则这些选择都具有相当大的风险。

sentences.en: What the Ukrainians say they would like to see happen is for the world to basically call
sentences.zh: 乌克兰人希望看到的是世界基本上回击

sentences.en: Moscow's bluff, for ships to sail along a corridor, load up with grain, take that grain
sentences.zh: 莫斯科的虚张声势，让船只沿着走廊航行，装载谷物，将谷物

sentences.en: back out into the global market, and basically dare Russia to shoot an internationally flagged civilian ship.
sentences.zh: 重新带回全球市场，并基本上敢于俄罗斯向悬挂国际旗帜的民用船只开火。

sentences.en: But, even, you know, last week, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但甚至在，你知道的，上周

sentences.en: intelligence community was warning that Moscow and its navy were already mining this route in a way that they could then maybe try and
sentences.zh: 美国情报界就警告说，莫斯科及其海军已经在该航线布雷，这样一旦这些船只被炸毁，他们就可以

sentences.en: blame Ukraine should one of these ships blow up.
sentences.zh: 试图将责任推给乌克兰。

sentences.en: So, it's fraught with risk.
sentences.zh: 因此，这里面充满了风险。

sentences.en: And for this plan to have any chance of actually becoming a reality, even the Ukrainians say they
sentences.zh: 为了让这个计划有任何成为现实的可能，甚至连乌克兰人都表示他们

sentences.en: need something essential, which is Turkey, to signal that they will protect these ships moving through this corridor.
sentences.zh: 需要一个至关重要的条件，那就是土耳其发出信号，表明他们将保护穿过这条走廊的船只。

sentences.en: And Turkey taking that step would be a real break with Russia, right?
sentences.zh: 而土耳其采取这一步将是对俄罗斯的真正决裂，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, no matter how personally upset Erdogan might be with Putin for pulling out, to take such a step would basically side with Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，不管埃尔多安对普京退出的决定感到多么个人不满，采取这样一步基本上就是站在乌克兰一边了。

sentences.en: And he has very carefully positioned himself throughout the war as the broker between the two nations, rather than taking one side explicitly.
sentences.zh: 而且在整场战争中，他一直非常谨慎地将自己定位为两国之间的斡旋者，而不是明确偏袒任何一方。

sentences.en: And even if Turkey were to give this signal, you still have other added complications, particularly
sentences.zh: 即便土耳其发出这个信号，你仍然会遇到其他附加复杂情况，特别是

sentences.en: private shipping companies and insurers who might be loathe to send a ship through mine-infested waters with the threat of Russian warships shooting at them.
sentences.zh: 私营航运公司和保险公司，他们可能不愿在布满水雷的海域派遣船只，还要面对俄罗斯军舰向他们开火的威胁。

sentences.en: Yeah, that all sounds wildly unlikely to work.
sentences.zh: 是的，这一切听起来极不可能成功。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But again, you know, I think we've seen over the course of the 16 months of this war that the future is also fraught.
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，你知道的，我认为在这场历时16个月的战争中，我们已经看到未来同样充满变数。

sentences.en: So, I think, you know, at the moment, everyone's just watching and waiting to see what happens next.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想，你知道的，目前大家都在观望，等待下一步会发生什么。

sentences.en: And of course, the longer we wait for this situation to play out, the closer we get to another food crisis because of Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们等待这种局势发展的时间越长，由于俄罗斯入侵乌克兰而引发另一场粮食危机的可能性就越大。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I mean, there's already a million tons of grain waiting in ports in Odessa at the moment.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，目前敖德萨港口已经有一百万吨谷物在等待了。

sentences.en: And the more grain that piles up there, the less food there is on plates, on people's tables across the world.
sentences.zh: 那里堆积的谷物越多，世界上人们餐桌上的食物就越少。

sentences.en: Mark, thank you.
sentences.zh: 马克，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Matina.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，玛蒂娜。

sentences.en: On Monday, Russia expanded its assault on Ukraine's grain exports, using drones to attack a port along the Danube River, about 70 miles from the Black Sea.
sentences.zh: 周一，俄罗斯扩大了对乌克兰粮食出口的打击，动用无人机袭击了多瑙河沿岸的一个港口，该港口距离黑海约70英里。

sentences.en: The strike signaled that Russia is now seeking to destroy every available way for Ukraine to ship its grain to the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 这次袭击标志着俄罗斯现在正试图摧毁乌克兰向世界其他地区运送粮食的所有可行途径。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: In Israel on Monday, the far-right government of Benjamin Netanyahu followed through with its plan to limit the power of the country's Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 周一在以色列，本雅明·内塔尼亚胡的极右翼政府兑现了限制该国最高法院权力的计划。

sentences.en: Despite protests from tens of thousands of Israelis and the explicit opposition of the Biden administration, the plan, adopted during a dramatic vote by Israel's parliament, would
sentences.zh: 尽管成千上万的以色列人举行抗议，且拜登政府明确表示反对，该计划在以色列议会戏剧性的投票中获得通过，这将

sentences.en: prevent the court from overturning many decisions made by Netanyahu and his ministers, shielding his government from traditional judicial oversight.
sentences.zh: 阻止最高法院推翻内塔尼亚胡及其部长们做出的许多决定，从而保护其政府免受传统的司法监督。

sentences.en: The battle over the judiciary has become one of the biggest political showdowns in modern
sentences.zh: 这场关于司法权的争斗已成为现代以色列历史上

sentences.en: Israeli history, pitting secular Israelis who opposed the plan against religious nationalists who supported it.
sentences.zh: 最大的政治对决之一，反对该计划的世俗以色列人与支持该计划的宗教民族主义者针锋相对。

sentences.en: Dozens of major businesses shut down on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一，数十家大型企业关闭。

sentences.en: Israel's largest labor union said it may call for a national strike, and more than 10,000 military reservists are threatening to resign from duty.
sentences.zh: 以色列最大的工会表示可能会呼吁举行全国大罢工，有一万多名预备役军人威胁要辞职。

sentences.en: On Monday night, Netanyahu seemed to acknowledge the protesters during a televised speech, offering to postpone a plan for even bigger changes to the country's court system.
sentences.zh: 周一晚上，内塔尼亚胡在电视演讲中似乎向抗议者做出了让步，提出推迟对该国法院系统进行更大规模变动的计划。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Will Reed, Claire Tennesketter, and Rob Zipko.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由威廉·里德、克莱尔·特内斯凯特和罗布·齐普科制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by M.J.
sentences.zh: 由M.J.

sentences.en: Davis-Linn with help from Lisa Chow.
sentences.zh: 戴维斯-林恩剪辑，丽莎·周提供了帮助。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Marion Lozano, Ali Shiba Itup, and Dan Powell, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 包含马里恩·洛扎诺、阿里·希巴·伊图普和丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐，由克里斯·伍德担任音频工程。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由旺德利的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《今日》节目的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是玛蒂娜·斯蒂夫斯-格拉德内夫。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会晕厥过去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
